content: Sandbox base image: docker/sandbox-templates:claude-code (Ubuntu, non-root 'agent' user with sudo, /home/agent; uid 1000 per contrib kits). Docker contrib kit claude-sbx-statusline README: jq, git, awk, hostname 'All are present on the claude-code base image'; andrewlock (2026-04-14) and dev.to corroborate git+jq preinstalled; claude-code-minimal variant has fewer tools. Settings.json: platform seeds /home/agent/.claude/settings.json late at create and overwrites (claude-mem kit comment); community reports fresh settings.json on each sbx run (vrchr.fr sbx 0.38.0) -> startup reconcile merge with wait-for-themeId pattern.
